gameRules:
Game: GraveGain3D
Genre: RPG
About: A dark fantasy action RPG featuring emoji-based 3D billboard visuals, immersive real-time lighting, procedural dungeons, a dialogue system, and a starship management hub.
How to play: Choose your race and class, clear procedurally generated 3D dungeon floors, collect Gold, and buy upgrades. Return to the LuckyStarShip hub to grow offline crops, exchange gold, and repair modules.
Controls: WASD / Arrow Keys: Move (Top-down) or Accelerate/Climb (Platformer); Space: Jump (Platformer) / Interact (Top-down); Left-Click: Melee / Primary Skill (Hold for Charge Attack); Right-Click: Block / Projectile Skill; Shift: Active Class Ability / Sprint Lunge; E: Enter/Exit Sidescroller Buildings; Escape / P: Pause Game; touch; mouse
